review_kind: Independent exact forward SQL correction review before local application
scope: Only the existing attested local postgres and gis_t1_upgrade databases after exact migration 032. Forward version 33 ledger INSERT only.

findings.detail: Actual post-032 enqueue exposed PostgreSQL 42703: CASE referenced NEW.job_id on a jobs record. Static review did not detect this runtime polymorphic-record error. Applied 032 is preserved; 033 uses separate IF statements referencing only concrete relation fields.
The attempts-only NEW.state check is also in a nested IF so result records without a state field cannot cause the same class of error before Boolean short circuiting.

All original report-validation, result equality, successful attempt and Native V2 invariants remain. Expired crashed attempts may retain NULL reports, while successful and failed native attempts still require their report invariants.
The SECURITY DEFINER function retains fixed pg_catalog,gis search_path and private runtime ACL revocations. No role, schema, public privilege or RLS expansion is introduced.
Guard binds exact 032 checksum, local cluster/database/runtime marker/baseline and rejects existing version 33. There is no data UPDATE, DELETE or old ledger write.

execution_conditions: Re-attest local target and all applied migration checksums immediately before execution.
Execute only exact reviewed bytes and append the actual version 33 SHA256 atomically in one transaction.
Retest trigger paths on jobs, editions, attempts and results for V1 and Native V2, including enqueue, successful completion, failed validation, recovery and deferred report bypass rejection.
Preserve 000-032 source and old ledger rows; any further applied-SQL correction requires another forward migration.
evidence_boundary: Static independent correction review only. Reviewer has not applied SQL, mutated database resources or independently rerun runtime tests. Final T3 acceptance remains dependent on actual tests and preservation evidence.
